_comment: Declared context headroom per skill/step (tokens). The context-guard.cjs UserPromptSubmit
hook reads this to block a developer reply when remaining < declared, preventing a step
from starting on an exhausted session. Values come from the budget table in each skill.
model_windows: set to match the model in use. Default 200K is safe but conservative —
update to 1000000 for 1M-context models so the guard only fires when genuinely needed.
To add a new skill: add a key under 'skills' with step → headroom pairs. The skill
participates by writing .claude/active-task.json at each STEP BOUNDARY. See
